create_setup_agent: create a custom DeerFlow agent by providing a SOUL.md personality definition and a one-line description
setup_agent_with_config: setup an agent with a name and description that writes a config.yaml and SOUL.md to the agents directory
validate_agent_name: validate an agent name string using the deerflow agents_config validation function
get_agent_paths: get agent directory paths using the deerflow config paths module for agent file storage
handle_agent_creation_error: handle agent creation errors by cleaning up newly created agent directories on failure
